scaffold: Step 1, label from the 30°: H = 12, x is O. Step 2, have H, want O. Step 3, SOH. Step 4, sin 30° = x ÷ 12, and sin 30° = ½. Step 5, x is on top, so multiply: 12 × ½ = …
hint: sin 30° = x ÷ 12. Read sin 30° from the table.
working: Step 1, label from the 30°: H = 12, x is O. Step 2, have H, want O. Step 3, SOH. Step 4, sin 30° = x ÷ 12, and sin 30° = ½. Step 5, x is on top, so multiply: 12 × ½ = 6. Step 6, 6 cm.

misconceptions.message: You divided by ½. O is on top of the fraction, so multiply.
That is the hypotenuse. O is half of it at 30°.
You halved twice. Multiply 12 by ½ once.

scaffold: Step 1, label from the 60°: H = 8, x is A. Step 2, have H, want A. Step 3, CAH. …
hint: cos 60° = x ÷ 8. Read cos 60° from the table.
working: Step 1, label from the 60°: H = 8, x is A. Step 2, have H, want A. Step 3, CAH. Step 4, cos 60° = x ÷ 8, and cos 60° = ½. Step 5, x is on top, so multiply: 8 × ½ = 4. Step 6, 4 cm.

misconceptions.message: You divided by ½. A is on top, so multiply.
That is the hypotenuse. cos 60° is ½, so A is half of it.
You halved twice. Multiply 8 by ½ once.

hint: Have A, want O. Which ratio has O and A?
working: Step 2: have A, want O. Step 3: TOA. Step 4: tan 45° = x ÷ 9, and tan 45° = 1. Step 5: x = 9 × 1 = 9. Step 6: 9 cm.

misconceptions.message: You used ½. That is sin 30°. tan 45° is 1.
You doubled. tan 45° is 1, so O equals A.

hint: Two sides given, angle wanted. Write O ÷ H, then find that value in the table.
working: Not a side: this is find an angle. sin θ = 5 ÷ 10 = ½. sin 30° = ½, so θ = 30°.

misconceptions.message: That is the ratio, sin θ = ½. The question wants the angle whose sin is ½.
½ is cos 60°, but you have O and H, so it is sin: find which angle has sin ½.
That is a side. The question asks for the angle.

stem: A ramp rises 3 m and makes an angle of 30° with the ground. How long is the ramp, in metres?
figure: <svg viewBox="0 0 240 135" width="100%" style="max-width:240px;display:block;margin:.4rem 0" font-family="-apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" role="img" aria-label="A ramp drawn as a right-angled triangle: the ramp is the sloping side, it makes 30° with the ground, and the vertical rise is 3 m"><title>A ramp drawn as a right-angled triangle: the ramp is the sloping side, it makes 30° with the ground, and the vertical rise is 3 m</title><polygon points="20,110 180,110 180,25" fill="#e6f4ec" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="2"/><polyline points="168,110 168,98 180,98" fill="none" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="1.5"/><path d="M 46 110 A 26 26 0 0 0 43 97" fill="none" stroke="#2b5797" stroke-width="1.5"/><text x="50" y="104" fill="#2b5797" font-weight="700">30°</text><text x="62" y="52" fill="#1d1d1b" font-weight="700">ramp</text><text x="185" y="72" fill="#1d1d1b" font-weight="700">3 m</text><text x="100" y="126" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1d1d1b" font-weight="700">ground</text></svg>
hint: The ramp is H. sin 30° = 3 ÷ H.
working: The height is O, across from the 30°. The ramp is H. Step 3: SOH. Step 4: ½ = 3 ÷ H. Step 5: H is on the bottom, so divide: H = 3 ÷ ½ = 6. Step 6: 6 m.

misconceptions.message: You multiplied. The ramp is H, on the bottom of the fraction, so divide.
That is the height. The ramp is the hypotenuse, and it is longer.
That is sin 30°, not a length.
